Team —

Quick sweep on stale opportunities across the US book. Finance flagged several deals with old close dates pushing our commit accuracy off by ~2.1M for Q2. I exported the queue (attached) and highlighted a shortlist where ownership looks stale or unverified.

Action items: please do one of the following for every row you own by EOD Tuesday (5/30):
- Claim it (reply "I own") and upload evidence to the CloseProof sheet
- Transfer to another owner (reply with new owner)
- Archive if it is dead (mark stage = Closed Lost with reason)

Priority callouts:
- Catalyst Health — DEAL-4521: has a close date of 2028-06-15 but no recent activity in 45 days. See "DEAL-4521_TeamNotes.txt" attached.
- Several opportunities in stage "Negotiation" with no activity longer than 60 days.

Attachments: stale_deals_export.csv (CSV), DEAL-4521_TeamNotes.txt (TXT)

Please ping me if you need a brief sync. Finance will run a pre-close proof next Friday and will use the uploaded evidence.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Operations Manager
